newsitem.title: UK: IBCA gives UAP Provincial Insurance claims rating.
newsitem.headline: IBCA gives UAP Provincial Insurance claims rating.

text.p: IBCA, the European credit rating agency, said on Thursday it assigned a claims settling ability rating of AA to UAP Provincial Insurance Plc.
The company, based in Kendal, is a multi-line non-life insurer operating throughout Britain. It is primarily an underwriter of small to medium-sized commercial risks and personal lines, IBCA said.

"The company's published underwriting results have shown losses in the past. However, a very conservative technical reserving policy had, to an extent, masked the true underwriting position, while above average operating costs have also contributed to the underwriting deficit," IBCA said.
Action by management to control expenses is underway, the rating agency said.
Union des Assurances de Paris is the parent company of UAP Provincial.

"A carefully managed investment portfolio has generated income and capital gains that contributed to a return-on-equity that has consistently bettered the UK market average since 1990," IBCA said. "UAP Provincial's technical reserving philosophy is conservative, with reserves steadily strengthening year on year."
The company's liquidity is good and the 1995 solvency margin of 72.4 percent is assessed as very satisfactory for the size and nature of the business, the agency said.
"It is IBCA's view that the company possesses a balanced portfolio underpinned by sound underwriting discipline.

"Multi-channel distribution and diverse product lines provide a degree of protection from some of the competitive pressures that prevail in the UK market, reflected in good 1996 interim results that are ahead of target.

"The recent listing on the London Stock Exchange of UAP Provincial's holding company, Sun Life & Provincial Holding Plc, improves the financial flexibility of the group and raises its market profile," IBCA said.
